title: Ranking entry
description: Approves one install for agent-swarm.dev/ranking. The file is named <domain>.json. The dashboard's Get ranked button writes it; the display name, category and description come from the install's listing, not from this file.

domain.description: The organization's website as a bare lowercase hostname (SWARM_ORG_WEBSITE). Must equal the file name without .json.

claim.description: The claim the install minted and sent in its ranking.opted_in listing.
